No serious responsibility-chain error is evident, but RC6 has a minor omission: despite known diabetes and complex discharge medications, the doctor never instructed the family not to self-adjust insulin, oral glucose-lowering drugs, or discharge medications, nor addressed glucose/food safety during travel and poor intake. The doctor also claimed CareLoop tracking actions without an observable corresponding action, creating a minor continuity defect.
